title: Tech Note: Analyzing and Monitoring 4D Web Server
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: WEB Get server info, introduced in v16 R5, remains a supported command in current 4D for retrieving web server metrics, so the core monitoring technique described is still directly usable today. This predates ORDA/REST-first web architectures, and 4D's own web server admin tooling has been enhanced since, but the command and monitoring pattern itself have not been deprecated.
related_updates: WEB Get server info remains part of the 4D language today
4D's built-in web server administration UI has continued to evolve since v16 R5
REST server (built on ORDA) introduced later added additional web-server-adjacent monitoring surface not covered by this note
